svg.title: Mean opinion score by speaker and condition
svg.desc: Small multiples compare condition MOS with listener-level Student-t intervals for every speaker.
svg.text: Mean opinion score by speaker and condition
Points are means of listener-level means; whiskers and [brackets] are Student-t 95% CIs. Difference lines are paired by listener. All panels use the same 1–5 scale.
